Comment: Aegis agent orchestration — a Step Functions STARTING-POINT TREE covering all core state types (Pass, Task, Choice, Map, Parallel, Wait, Succeed, Fail) and patterns (Retry, Catch, fan-out via Map, human-in-the-loop via .waitForTaskToken). Architecture A (§1.3): Step Functions owns durable orchestration; the Aegis broker decides allow | human_approve | deny; a fooled model reaches nothing. Placeholders ${agent_lambda_arn} and ${approval_queue_url} are injected by Terraform.

Initialize.Comment: Pass — seed run context. $$.Execution.Name is the durable run id (Architecture A: SF owns 'how far did we get?').

FanOutToolCalls.Comment: Map — FAN-OUT (span-out): mediate every proposed tool call as an independent branch, then fan-in. INLINE mode so .waitForTaskToken works inside the iterator.

Mediate.Comment: Task — invoke the Aegis agent Lambda. The broker returns allow | human_approve | deny; the model's output is only a request.

DecisionChoice.Comment: Choice — branch on the broker's deterministic decision.

ExecuteTool.Comment: Pass — stand-in for running the tool the broker allowed (low/reversible).

RequestApproval.Comment: Task .waitForTaskToken — HUMAN-IN-THE-LOOP. The lethal trifecta (or an irreversible effect) pauses here durably. The token is sent to SQS; a human (or the approver Lambda) calls SendTaskSuccess to resume.

ApprovedExecute.Comment: Pass — a human approved the high-consequence action; run it now.

Denied.Comment: Pass — broker denied, or approval timed out / was rejected. Record and move on.

MediateFailed.Comment: Pass — mediation itself errored after retries. Fail closed for this item.

ItemDone.Comment: Succeed — this iterator item is complete.

PostProcess.Comment: Parallel — independent post-processing branches run concurrently.

Audit.Comment: Pass — would append the decisions to the aegis-ledger (immutable audit).

Summarize.Comment: Pass — summarize the fan-out decisions for the caller.

SettleWait.Comment: Wait — a timed pause (e.g., let an eventually-consistent write settle).

OrchestrationFailed.Comment: Fail — terminal failure if the fan-out itself fails unrecoverably.
OrchestrationFailed.Cause: One or more tool-call mediations failed unrecoverably.
